question.text: The radiation emitted by the surface of the Sun emits maximum power at a wavelength of about <math><mn>500</mn></math> <math><mi mathvariant="normal">n</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">m</mi></math>. Assuming the Sun to be a blackbody emitter. If its surface temperature <math><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">K</mi></mrow></mfenced></math> is given by <math><mi mathvariant="normal">α</mi><mo>∙</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">β</mi><mo>×</mo><msup><mrow><mn>10</mn></mrow><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">γ</mi></mrow></msup></math> then fill the value of <math><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">α</mi><mo>+</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">β</mi><mo>+</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">γ</mi></mrow></mfenced></math>. (Wien’s constant is given by <math><mn>2.898</mn></math> <math><mi mathvariant="normal">m</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">m </mi><mi mathvariant="normal">K</mi></math> )
